title: Thirteen Winters and One Short Lane
subtitle: 居住环境 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 居住环境（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）
meta: 主题语境：居住环境（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）　|　核心词汇：estate　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 estate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1892 my great-uncle ① managed an estate that no agent in the county would have valued, and he said the managing was the whole of the winter. The ② estate, meaning the land itself and not the house, ran thirteen winters and stayed unvalued in the book; an estate, he said, is the only thing in a county that is judged by how long it is left unvalued.

Every ③ estate in that county had the same short lane beside it, and the ④ estate at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the tenant and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An estate, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to value; my great-uncle said the valuing is the part that fills thirteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the estate was the whole of the will, meaning the property and not the land. The ⑥ estate, meaning the property and not any of that, is the only thing in a will that everybody waits for and nobody values; estate, he said, is either something you manage or the only word that means both land and property. He said the property is the part they remember.

By 1900 the ⑦ estate had become a line in a deed, and the deed had become an argument about the short lane. The ⑧ estate of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in January, was one county and thirteen winters of valuing; estate, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to value. He said the valuing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ estate I remember is the one valued in the deed, which closed in 1905 and is still described as the quietest in the county. An ⑩ estate, my mother said in 1907, is the only one that improves by being valued; every estate, she said, is a property that has agreed to look like a piece of land. She said the property was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 庄园；地产（指郡里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 地产（指那片土地本身，与宅子相对）
C. 固定搭配：manage an estate 管理一处庄园／地产
D. n. 地产（指留给佃户的那一处）
E. n. 地产（抽象总称，指一个郡里的产业之事）
F. n. 地产（指契约上写到、被估价的那一处）
G. n. 遗产；全部财产（指遗嘱里人人都等却无人估价的那样东西）
H. n. 财产（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人估价的那样东西）

items.q: managed an estate that no agent in the county would have valued
The estate, meaning the land itself and not the house
the estate at the far side
the estate was the whole of the will
the estate had become a line in a deed
The estate of the whole thing
An estate, my mother said in 1907

answers.why: manage an estate 意为“管理一处庄园／地产”，1892 年曾叔父管理了一处郡里没有一位经纪人肯估价的地产。
estate 意为“地产”，指那片土地本身而不是宅子，它经过了十三个冬天而在簿子上没有价钱。
estate 意为“地产”，指郡里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一条短短的小路。
estate 意为“地产”，指留给佃户的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
estate 意为“遗产、全部财产”，指遗嘱里人人都等却无人估价的那样东西，叔叔说这份遗产就是那份遗嘱的全部。
estate 意为“财产”，指人人都等却无人估价的那样东西而不是那片土地，是遗嘱里人人都等、却无人估价的东西。
estate 意为“地产”，指契约上写到、被估价的那一处，到 1900 年这一处成了契约里的一行。
estate 意为“地产”，曾叔父一月写道，整件事的产业之事是一个郡和十三个冬天的估价。
estate 意为“地产”，我记得的是契约上估价的那一处，1905 年结束了，至今仍被说成郡里最安静的一处。
estate 为抽象总称，母亲 1907 年说，一处地产是唯一会因为被好好估价而变得更好的东西。
